# office noun market

58 listed coins: ./coins.json (https://officenoun.xyz/market/coins.json).
Fields: name, ticker, mint, image, blurb. No private financial data.
Machine-readable guide: ./agents.json.

Live data: GeckoTerminal primary (batches of 30); Jupiter v3 for missing
prices; DexScreener when GeckoTerminal fails entirely. pump.fun frontend API
is not used. Unknown fields remain unknown; estimated caps are marked.

Trading: official Jupiter Plugin, https://plugin.jup.ag/plugin-v1.js,
integrated with SOL as initial input and the selected coin as initial output
and fixedMint. Flip direction to sell. Visitors connect their own wallet in
the widget. No custody, keys, server signing, referral fee or auto-connect.
Jupiter can route pump.fun bonding curves; new or illiquid coins may have no
quote. The pump.fun link remains the fallback.
Buy: https://jup.ag/swap?sell=So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112&buy={mint}
Sell: https://jup.ag/swap?sell={mint}&buy=So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112
Fallback: https://pump.fun/coin/{mint}
Page selection: ./?trade=TICKER or ./?trade=MINT or ./#trade=TICKER.
Use the full mint from coins.json in Jupiter links.

Desk game: a desk game. hours and memos stay on this device. they are not
money, not tokens, and not a prize. localStorage key: officenoun-desk-v1.
One click earns one hour; every fifth files a memo. Hours unlock cosmetic
coin art. No idle or offline accrual. ?clockin=1 clocks in once per load.
After coins load, window.OfficeNounDesk.state() returns a copy of
{ hours, memos, unlocked: string[] } (tickers); clockIn() clocks in once and
returns state; reset() confirms before clearing the save and returns state.
No API spends real tokens or signs transactions.
